The use of epidural anesthesia during laparoscopy—a specific subpopulation of clinical indicator 8—varies significantly across [[danmark|Danmark]], with a national average of 39.9% in the current reporting year (September 2024 to August 2025) [^src1]. This represents a slight, steady increase from 37.9% in 2022/23 and 39.7% in 2023/24 [^src1]. The data highlights substantial decentralization in anesthetic practices, with no single national target or threshold mandated for this specific subpopulation, making the variation a reflection of local clinical preferences rather than compliance failures.

At the regional level, [[hovedstaden-region-i-alt|Hovedstaden Region i alt]] leads with the highest adoption rate at 46.4%, while [[nordjylland-region-i-alt|Nordjylland Region i alt]] records the lowest at 33.5% [^src1]. However, [[nordjylland-region-i-alt|Nordjylland Region i alt]] demonstrates the most notable upward trend, growing from just 22.7% in 2022/23 to 33.5% in the current year [^src1]. [[midtjylland-region-i-alt|Midtjylland Region i alt]] and [[syddanmark-region-i-alt|Syddanmark Region i alt]] remain relatively flat, hovering around the mid-to-high 30s across all three years [^src1].

Hospital-level data reveals stark outliers at both ends of the spectrum. [[amager-og-hvidovre-hospital|Amager og Hvidovre Hospital]] consistently leads the country, maintaining a high rate of 65.7% in the current year, largely stable from previous years [^src1]. [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] follows at 61.0%, though this marks a decline from its peak of 70.8% in 2023/24 [^src1]. Other notable leaders include [[holbaek-sygehus|Holbæk Sygehus]] (57.3%) and [[regionshospitalet-goedstrup|Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]] (55.0%) [^src1]. 

Conversely, several hospitals report very low utilization. [[naestved-slagese-og-ringsted-sygehuse|Næstved, Slagelse og Ringsted sygehuse]] report the lowest clear rate at 14.3%, down from 22.8% in 2022/23 [^src1]. [[sygehus-lillebaelt|Sygehus Lillebælt]] also records a low rate of 16.2% [^src1]. Two facilities, [[rigshospitalet|Rigshospitalet]] (14.3%) and [[bornholms-hospital|Bornholms Hospital]] (28.6%), show suppressed patient counts (indicated by "#/#") and exceptionally wide confidence intervals, identifying them as statistical outliers due to very low case volumes for this specific procedure combination [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner andelen af patienter, der modtog epidural-anæstesi ved laparoskopi på nationalt, regionalt og hospitalsniveau i perioden 01.09.2024–31.08.2025 samt tidligere år, og viser en generel lav andel (<50 %) på nationalt plan, med størst variation blandt sygehuse — hvor Amager og Hvidovre Hospital og Aarhus Universitetshospital ligger over 60 %, mens flere små hospitaler ligger under 20 %.
